_: Town pages (dev/villes/build.mjs). zone: every commune of the listed départements whose centre lies within rayonKm of centre and with at least populationMin inhabitants (geo.api.gouv.fr, at build time). communes: extra communes by INSEE code, the name checked against geo.api.gouv.fr. reperes: towns the parents of the area know, for « à 6 km d'Obernai ». A commune without at least 4 named quest places gets no page.
